column_description: Unique identifier for each access event.
ID of the pose estimation being accessed. may be NULL.
ID of the user accessing the pose estimation. may be NULL.
Date when the pose estimation was accessed. may be NULL.
Type of access (e.g., view, download). always exactly one of 'view', 'download'. may be NULL.
IP address of the user. may be NULL.
User agent of the user. may be NULL.
Duration of the access. may be NULL.
